programme.title: McDonald \u0026 Dodds
programme.desc: Five friends go on a hot air balloon trip.However, only four of them return to Bath.The last one, Frankie Marsh, is found dead after falling out of a bin.McDonald and Dodds begin an investigation to determine whether it was an accident or whether the man was pushed out.To discover the truth, detectives must go back to the events of the 1980s. They are assisted in the investigation by Roy Gilbert, an investigator specializing in plane crashes, who also seems to be connected to this case.

programme.title: Death in Paradise 15
programme.desc: Detective Mervin Wilson (Don Gilet) returns to the charming island of Saint Marie - a tropical corner of the Caribbean full of sun, which, however, hides numerous secrets beneath its idyllic surface.The investigator is still trying to find his place here.He is also taking on further criminal cases.He investigates, among other things, the circumstances of the poisoning of a local newspaper reporter, the alleged attack of a legendary beast on a lecturer, and the death of a professional killer.Additionally, he intervenes when the body of a couples therapist is found on the beach of a luxury resort.Additionally, an unexpected meeting with his stepbrother draws him into a series of unexpected events.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders 20
programme.desc: Another season of a crime series set in the fictional British county of Midsomer.In this seemingly peaceful area, whose inhabitants form closed communities, people die surprisingly often.The circumstances in which the murders occur are investigated by Chief Inspector John Barnaby (Neil Dudgeon), who replaced his cousin, Tom.The investigations conducted by him and his assistants often reveal the secrets of the people of Midsomer.It turns out that the owners of well-kept houses and afternoon tea patrons are no strangers to sick ambitions, jealousy and hatred that force them to commit cruel acts.

programme.title: My Family 2
programme.desc: Ben (Robert Lindsay) and Susan (Zoë Wanamaker) Harper are a middle-class couple living in the Chiswick district of London.Their three children live with them: Nick (Kris Marshall), Janey (Daniela Denby-Ashe) and Michael (Gabriel Thomson).Ben is a dentist who values ​​peace and quiet.Susan makes all the important decisions in the family.She works in London as a tour guide and has a hard time adapting to the stereotype of a woman cooking dinner for her husband.The eldest son, Nick, is not very bright, has problems finding a permanent job and spends most of his time in front of the TV.Janey is only interested in clothes and boys, and the youngest, Michael, is an intelligent boy and the mascot of the whole family.He doesn't find a common language with his father, but spends all day in front of the computer.

programme.title: Blue Lights 3
programme.desc: Two years have passed since Grace (Sian Brooke), Annie (Katherine Devlin) and Tommy (Nathan Braniff) joined the intervention patrol.They have already become accustomed to the realities of service.However, new incidents in the Mount Eden district reveal new, disturbing aspects of the world hidden under the city's seemingly calm surface.Although the police had previously managed to dismantle local criminal structures, an international gang takes control of the Belfast underworld, subjugating people from various walks of life.Officers quickly discover that organized crime even uses the help of lawyers and accountants.
